Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: Mg and Ti atoms each have 12 geometric neighbors, with neighbor distances spanning roughly 3.04–3.36 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 16 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts show Mg–Mg, Mg–Ti, and Ti–Ti 12-vertex coordination polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces.
